title: voacanga thouarsii var. dregei
intro: Voacanga thouarsii var. dregei, commonly known as the African Voacanga, is a plant species native to tropical Africa, belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress, improving sleep quality, and enhancing cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Voacanga thouarsii var. dregei are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including voacangine and voacorine, which exhibit sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant, particularly alkaloids, have been shown to possess neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory effects, contributing to its potential therapeutic applications.
